verdict.rationale: Phaser ships hosted, account-based services, including the Phaser Game Agent and its MCP server, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, opt-out controls, or any data-retention or privacy policy for these AI features. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
